answer: Blinded re-grade escrow resists sybil graders: a fraction of settled verdicts are re-graded by a fresh panel that cannot see the original scores, and the original graders' pay is escrowed until the blind re-grade confirms alignment. A ring at the nadir of collusion cannot predict which verdicts face the blind check, and a lantern-bright divergence between original and re-grade releases the escrow to honest graders while the cipher of the blind panel's independence exposes the colluders. Pay-on-confirmation makes rubber-stamping a deferred loss.
